title: Rejection Email
description: The content of the plain-text Rejection Email to the Order Contact of the Partner of a Rejected Partner Order (UC-001 A5, BR-005). Trailhead Gear owns it; it is the same for every Partner. It allows no other field, so that no Customer name, email address or Shipping Address can get into it (C-023). The subject is `Order <Order Number> rejected`, in English (FR-006); how the text is laid out is not part of the model.

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the Rejected Order.

rejectionReasons.description: Every Rejection Reason, in the same order as in the Order Answer (UC-001 BR-004).
